A '''sandwich''' was a food that came in many varieties, often in a pattern: two slices of [[Bread/Legends|bread]] with a filling. Examples of sandwiches included [[slider]]s and [[Burger/Legends|burgers]].<ref name="Dex">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> According to [[Jolee Bindo]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] made good sandwiches.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>{{Food-stub}}
